anatomy.demo: Dark baseSignalContentControl

parts.desc: 用分层灰度而不是纯黑支撑长时间阅读
parts.desc_en: Layered grays rather than pure black for sustained reading

parts.desc: 少量高亮色用于状态、行动和真正重要的数据
parts.desc_en: A small number of bright colors reserved for status, action, and critical data

parts.desc: 真实内容、步骤、日志、指标或结果构成视觉主体
parts.desc_en: Real content, steps, logs, metrics, or outcomes as the visual subject

parts.desc: 关键控制保持清楚，技术氛围不能盖过操作
parts.desc_en: Clear controls that remain usable beneath the technical atmosphere

use.t: 影音、音乐和创作工具：深色环境能让内容本身成为视觉焦点
开发者工具、AI 和数据产品：代码、状态与控制台能自然进入页面
需要长时间聚焦的界面：通过分层灰度减少无关视觉刺激
品牌强调精确和沉浸感：深色基底能让少量颜色与内容更有力量

dont.t: 高亮效果覆盖大部分内容：会弱化层级，并增加长时间阅读负担
用无关代码充当产品展示：无法说明产品的真实能力、状态或工作流
正文使用过细低对比灰：深色并不意味着可以牺牲可读性
为严肃工具加入过多赛博元素：噪声和故障效果可能削弱可靠感

principles.t: 先保证深色环境中的可读性：正文、边界和状态需要保持可区分的对比层级
高亮色承担明确职责：运行、成功、风险和主要行动各自稳定
展示真实内容或产品状态：影像、画布、步骤、日志和结果都比无意义装饰更可信
光效只负责聚焦：局部渐变和发光强调关键区域，不覆盖所有边界

entry.prompt: 为云端自动化工具做深色官网。用现有的真实运行步骤、服务状态和结果数据解释产品，正文和主要操作必须清楚可读；可以用少量高亮和光效区分状态，但不应让装饰取代任务信息。状态与数据只采用可核验来源，资料不足时先标为“待补充”并说明需要什么，不要虚构运行结果。
entry.prompt_en: Dark UI product website, layered charcoal background, precise hairline borders, limited cyan-green and violet signals, real product steps, runtime status and data metrics, local soft glow, high-contrast body text, professional and reliable rather than cyberpunk

references.title: prefers-color-scheme：深色模式完全指南
references.title_en: prefers-color-scheme: Hello darkness, my old friend

en.prompt: Dark UI product website, layered charcoal background, precise hairline borders, limited cyan-green and violet signals, real product steps, runtime status and data metrics, local soft glow, high-contrast body text, professional and reliable rather than cyberpunk

use.t: Media, music, and creative tools where a dark environment lets the work itself remain central
Developer tools, AI, and data products that can naturally show code, status, and console states
Interfaces that support sustained focus, using layered grays to reduce irrelevant visual stimulation
Brands expressing precision or immersion, where a dark base gives limited color and content more force

dont.t: Turn every element into neon; hierarchy disappears and sustained reading becomes tiring
Use random code as product proof; technical visitors will recognize the emptiness quickly
Set body text in thin, low-contrast gray; dark design still needs comfortable reading
Apply cyberpunk noise to a serious tool; glitch and clutter can undermine reliability

principles.t: Protect readability in the dark environment: body text, boundaries, and status cannot collapse into one gray layer
Give each signal color a job: running, success, risk, and the primary action should remain consistent
Show real content or product state: media, canvases, steps, logs, and results feel more credible than meaningless decoration
Use light effects to focus: local glow can emphasize a key area without covering every boundary
